reason: The verifier's evidence was the weakest of the four, a scan it said it had searched, with the chapter fixed only by saying the speech falls between the openings of chapters 9 and 10. I refetched that scan and extracted its text myself with pdftotext, and it holds. The sentence stands exactly as quoted, full stop included, inside Shevek's speech: We know it, because we have had to learn it. We know that there is no help for us but from one another, that no hand will save us if we do not reach out our hand. And the hand that you reach out is empty, as mine is. The chapter is 9: the same text's chapter list gives Chapter 9 as SHEVEK was awakened by the bells in the chapel tower pealing the Prime Harmony, the Urras chapter, and the reading-guide questions for chapter 9 in the same file cover this chapter's material while chapter 10's cover Anarres and Sadik. The square is named in the novel's own words, Capitol Square, with the Senate and the Directorate on it, in Nio Esseia, so the corrected locator is the book's and not the verifier's. Written in English, no translation to drift; Harper and Row 1974 is the first publisher. Shevek is named as speaker. shipped.js: nothing shipped, nothing near, Le Guin at zero for the year, not banned, once in September. Tag Fiction, pre-2000, source line leads with the name, no dash, 120 characters. Publishability: the quotation is clean, and although the helicopters open fire on the crowd a page later, none of that is in the line or needed to place it. Not refuted.
